Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a summary of capital appropriations by legislative district to accompany each capital appropriations bill.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to capital budget appropriation transparency; andadding a new section to chapter 43.88 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.88 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For each capital appropriation bill considered by the full bodyor fiscal committees of either chamber of the legislature it must beaccompanied by a summary of capital appropriations by legislativedistrict. (2) The summary of capital appropriations by legislative districtmust include the following categories for each legislative district: (a) The total level of all appropriations; (b) The level of appropriations attributable to competitive loanprograms; (c) The level of appropriations to state agency projects; (d) The level of appropriations to state institutions of highereducation; and (e) The level of all other appropriations which are attributable toan individual district. p. 1 SB 5716 (3) The summary of capital appropriations required by this sectionmust include the percent of total capital appropriations eachlegislative district would receive. (4) For the purposes of this section, a capital appropriation billincludes the original capital appropriations bill filed by a member ofthe house or the senate, any substitute bill, and any strikingamendment.
